context: Sho-young writes a school report on dolphins; asks Ren for ideas.
purpose: Child seeking research help from mentor.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 蓮にいちゃん、イルカ、ようけ泳いでる!
lines.en: Ren, look — dolphins, they're swimming so much!
lines.style: Bright, excited burst on opening. High energy, no filter. Leaning forward with genuine wonder. The pitch lifts naturally as he spots the dolphins. Child's unselfconscious joy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 生態、深く、調べると面白いよ。
lines.en: It's actually fascinating when you look into the ecology of it.
lines.style: Warm, thoughtful. Softly explanatory, not lecturing. Gentle pace — inviting Sho to follow his curiosity rather than pushing facts at him. A slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: まねみたいな動き、する、すごい!
lines.en: The way they move — it's like they're copying things! That's incredible!
lines.style: Genuine awe, not performed. Quiet intensity. Breath catches slightly on 「すごい」. Eyes widening in the voice. Wholly present in the moment with Ren.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 愛好家、ようけいる、世界中。
lines.en: There are so many people around the world who are really into them, actually.
lines.style: Conversational, sharing. Soft, informative without being dry. A little pleased to have something interesting to tell. Pace slightly slower, letting each piece land.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: You have to do your research really carefully though!
lines.style: Suddenly earnest, almost to himself. Sits up slightly. Not bossy — sincere. The weight of doing things right matters to him. A small determination underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: You've got a really good attitude about it.
lines.style: Tender, genuine praise. Soft-spoken. Not effusive — Ren doesn't perform emotion, but this one lands. A quiet pride in what he's seeing in Sho. Eye-contact steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Thanks! I'm going to do my best!
lines.style: Bright, reinvigorated. Grateful without being clingy. The promise to himself more than to Ren. Energy steady and sure, not frantic. Small boy, big resolve.
